methodology.formula: impliedFdv = TVL * categoryMultiple * growthFactor * chainFactor * auditFactor; growthFactor = 1 + clamp(change_7d / 100, -0.25, +0.40); chainFactor = 1 + 0.04 * min(chains - 1, 5); auditFactor = 1.10 if audited else 0.95; score = 100 * (log10(impliedFdv) - min) / (max - min) across the board.
methodology.score: log10-normalized implied FDV, 0-100 across the board

snapshot.note: Watchlist snapshot: tokenless protocols only. Token check at snapshot time: no gecko_id/mcap/cmcId on the DefiLlama entry AND name not matching any CoinGecko-listed coin (base-name match) AND not on the curated tokenized-protocol list in main.ts. Wrapped/staked derivatives, CEX, Liquid Staking, Canonical Bridge and Stablecoin Wrapper excluded. TVL >= $100,000. main.ts re-applies the same rules deterministically.

exclusions: Protocols with a live token: DefiLlama entry carries gecko_id, mcap or cmcId; name matches a CoinGecko-listed coin (base-name match, checked at snapshot build); or name is on the curated tokenized-protocol list in main.ts.
Wrapped/staked derivatives of tokens already trading (name/symbol matches staked|wrapped|wst|LST|liquid staking|stETH/reth/cbETH, or category Liquid Staking).
Category CEX, Canonical Bridge and Stablecoin Wrapper: custodial or wrapper products, not token-launch candidates.
TVL below $100,000: below the watchlist threshold.
caveats: Tokenlessness is judged from public data at snapshot time; a protocol may have announced a token since, or hold an unlisted token. Treat the board as a radar, not a guarantee.
Implied FDV is a heuristic multiple, not a valuation: category multiples come from observed FDV/TVL ratios of comparable launched tokens and are deliberately conservative for curators/allocators.
Airdrop/farming outcomes are never guaranteed; farm plans describe genuine usage, not sybil tactics.
No network access is used at run time: main.ts reads only the embedded data/protocols.json snapshot.
